newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Williams esimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Williams esimates cut.

text.p: PaineWebber said on Tuesday it lowered its 1997 earnings estimate on Williams Cos, because of weaker-than-expected marketing margins and lower-than-expected contributions from its ethanol business.

-- PaineWebber analyst Ronald Barone said in a research note he was lowering his 1997 earnings estimate to $2.25 per share from $2.35 per share but was maintaining a 1998 estimate of $2.50 per share. Barone rated Williams a neutral.

-- "As a result of competitive pressures and the lack of volatility in gas prices in this quarter, natural gas marketing margins appear to be weak industry-wide," he said. "This challenging environment, combined with higher-than-expected corn prices, should result in a down quarter for the company."
